<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Reading Advantage Workbook - Lesson 1: Pip the Curious Puppy Feels</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Merriweather:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,700;1,400&family=Open+Sans:wght@400;600;700&family=Caveat:wght@500&display=swap');

        :root {
            --primary-blue: #1e40af;
            --primary-light: #3b82f6;
            --accent-orange: #f97316;
            --accent-green: #10b981;
            --accent-purple: #8b5cf6;
            --text-dark: #1f2937;
            --text-medium: #4b5563;
            --text-light: #6b7280;
            --bg-cream: #fefce8;
            --bg-light: #f8fafc;
            --border-light: #e5e7eb;
            --border-medium: #d1d5db;
        }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; /* Switch to Serif for main body */
            color: var(--text-dark);
            background: white;
            line-height: 1.7; /* Comfortable reading height */
            padding: 20px;
        }

        /* ... (Container styles) ... */

        .workbook-title {
            font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; /* Keep sans for metadata */
            /* ... */
        }

        .lesson-number {
            font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; /* Clean sans for numbers */
            /* ... */
        }

        /* ... */

        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dbeafe 0%, #ede9fe 100%);
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
            page-break-after: avoid;
            break-after: avoid;
        }

        .section-icon {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--primary-blue);
            color: white;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 14px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .section-title {
            flex: 1;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-blue);
            margin: 0;
        }

        .section-time {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* ... */

        .article-text {
            padding: 10px 0;
            font-family: 'Merriweather', serif;
            font-size: 15px; /* Slightly larger for readability */
            line-height: 2.0; /* Generous spacing */
            /* ... */
        }

        /* ... */

        .prompt-text {
            font-family: 'Merriweather', serif;
            font-size: 15px;
            /* ... */
        }

        /* Ensure form labels and UI text remain Sans-Serif */
        .collection-item label, .starter-label, .tip-label, .q-label, .a-label, .planning-label {
            font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
        }


        .paragraph {
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .para-number {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            background: var(--primary-blue);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-right: 8px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            vertical-align: top;
        }

        /* Collection Boxes */
        .collection-box {
            border: 2px dashed var(--border-medium);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 16px;
            background: var(--bg-light);
        }

        .collection-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .collection-item {
            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 10px;
        }

        .collection-item label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-light);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        /* Questions */
        .question-box {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            padding: 12px 0;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
            break-inside: avoid;
        }

        .question-box:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        /* Page continuation indicator */
        .page-continue {
            text-align: right;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text-light);
            margin-top: 20px;
            page-break-after: always;
            break-after: page;
        }

        .question-number {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            /* width: 24px;
            height: 24px; */
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            width: auto;
            height: auto;
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-right: 4px;
        }
        .question-number::after {
            content: ".";
        }

        .question-text {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .options {
            padding-left: 34px;
        }

        .option {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .option-circle {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-medium);
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .answer-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-top: 12px;
            padding-top: 10px;
            border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-light);
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .answer-field {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .answer-box {
            width: 30px;
            height: 24px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* Short Answer */
        .short-answer-box {
            background: var(--bg-cream);
            border: 2px solid #fde047;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 16px;
        }

        .sentence-starters {
            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 12px;
            margin: 12px 0;
        }

        .starter-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-purple);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .starter-item {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            font-style: italic;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            padding-left: 12px;
        }

        .starter-item::before {
            content: "•";
            margin-right: 8px;
            color: var(--accent-purple);
        }

        .writing-area {
            min-height: 100px;
        }

        .self-check {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-top: 12px;
            padding-top: 12px;
            border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-medium);
        }

        .check-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-medium);
        }

        /* Practice Section */
        .practice-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 40px; /* Generous gutter like a real book */
        }

        .practice-box {
            /* border: 1px solid var(--border-light); */
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 0;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
            break-inside: avoid;
        }

        .practice-title {
            font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-blue);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-green);
            padding-bottom: 6px;
            break-after: avoid;
        }

        .match-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .match-number {
            width: 20px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .match-word {
            flex: 1;
            color: var(--primary-blue);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .match-blank {
            width: 30px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--text-dark);
            margin: 0 10px;
        }

        .match-def {
            flex: 1;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .thai-translation {
            color: var(--text-light);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .match-letter {
            width: 20px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* Fill in blanks */
        .fill-blank {
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 2;
        }

        .blank {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 80px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--text-dark);
            margin: 0 4px;
        }

        .word-bank {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 10px;
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .word-bank-title {
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .bank-words {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .bank-word {
            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        /* Sentence Ordering */
        .sentence-order {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .order-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .order-box {
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-light);
        }

        .order-word {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            padding: 6px 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
        }

        /* Long Answer Writing */
        .writing-section {
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-purple);
            border-radius: 8px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .writing-header {
            background: var(--accent-purple);
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            break-after: avoid;
        }

        .writing-header h3 {
            font-size: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .writing-header p {
            font-size: 11px;
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        .prompt-box {
            background: #faf5ff;
            padding: 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e9d5ff;
        }

        .prompt-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-purple);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .prompt-text {
            font-family: 'Merriweather', serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .planning-area {
            padding: 16px;
            background: white;
        }

        .planning-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .planning-box {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 12px;
        }

        .planning-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .writing-line {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
            min-height: 24px;
            margin: 8px 0;
        }

        .writing-line-small {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            min-height: 20px;
            margin: 6px 0;
        }

        .writing-lines {
            padding: 20px;
            background: white;
        }

        .lined-area {
            min-height: 200px;
        }

        .word-count-box {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            gap: 20px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: var(--bg-light);
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        /* Reflection */
        .reflection-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #faf5ff 0%, #f0fdf4 100%);
            border: 1px solid #d8b4fe;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 16px;
        }

        .understanding-scale {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            margin: 12px 0;
        }

        .scale-option {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .scale-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dark);
        }

        .star-rating {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .rating-star {
            font-size: 20px;
            color: #fbbf24;
        }

        /* Homework */
        .homework-box {
            background: #fef2f2;
            border: 1px solid #fecaca;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 16px;
        }

        .homework-title {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #dc2626;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .homework-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .signature-line {
            margin-top: 16px;
            padding-top: 12px;
            border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-medium);
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        /* Answer Key Page */
        .answer-key {
            background: #f0f9ff;
            border: 2px solid var(--primary-light);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .answer-key h3 {
            color: var(--primary-blue);
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--primary-blue);
        }

        .answer-section {
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .answer-section h4 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .answer-list {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        /* Translation Section */
        .translation-section {
            background: #fff7ed;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-orange);
            border-radius: 8px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .translation-header {
            background: var(--accent-orange);
            color: white;
            padding: 10px 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .translation-content {
            padding: 16px;
        }

        .translation-para {
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .translation-para strong {
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }

        /* Article Images */
        .article-container {
            position: relative;
            overflow: auto; /* Clearfix to contain floated hero image */
        }

        .article-image-area {
            /* Hero images float left to wrap text across multiple paragraphs */
            float: left;
            width: 45%;
            margin: 0 25px 15px 0;
        }

        .article-image-box {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .article-image-box img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            display: block;
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        .article-image-caption {
            display: block;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-light);
            font-style: italic;
            margin-top: 6px;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .article-spacer {
            clear: both;
            height: 20px;
        }

        /* Utility Classes */
        .flex {
            display: flex;
        }

        .gap-2 {
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .gap-4 {
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .mt-2 {
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .mt-3 {
            margin-top: 12px;
        }

        .mt-4 {
            margin-top: 16px;
        }

        .mb-2 {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .mb-3 {
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .text-sm {
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .text-xs {
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .text-muted {
            color: var(--text-light);
        }

        .font-bold {
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .text-center {
            text-align: center;
        }

        /* Deep Reading Notes */
        .deep-reading-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .para-note {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 10px;
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        .para-note-number {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            background: var(--accent-orange);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .para-note-content {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .para-note-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-light);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        /* Language Questions */
        .language-q-box {
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .q-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--primary-blue);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .a-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-green);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-top: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        /* Score Box */
        .score-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dbeafe 0%, #ede9fe 100%);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .score-label {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--primary-blue);
        }

        .score-circles {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .score-circle {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border: 2px solid var(--primary-blue);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .performance-check {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .perf-option {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        /* QR Code */
        .qr-box {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            background: white;
            border: 2px dashed var(--primary-light);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            margin: 10px 0;
        }

        .qr-code {
            width: 96px;
            height: 96px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 9px;
            color: var(--text-light);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
        }

        .qr-text {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .qr-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--primary-blue);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .qr-desc {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            margin-top: 2px;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* Tip Box */
        .tip-box {
            background: #ecfdf5;
            border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-green);
            padding: 10px 14px;
            margin: 12px 0;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .tip-label {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-green);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        /* ============================================
           PRINT STYLES
           ============================================ */
        @media print {
            /* Reset backgrounds and colors for print */
            body {
                background: white !important;
                color: black !important;
                padding: 0;
                margin: 0;
            }

            .workbook-container {
                max-width: none;
                box-shadow: none;
                background: white !important;
                padding: 0;
                margin: 0;
            }

            /* Page breaks */
            .force-page-break {
                page-break-before: always;
                break-before: page;
            }

            .section.phase-3 {
                page-break-before: always;
                break-before: page;
            }

            /* Prevent page breaks inside these elements */
            .paragraph,
            .question-box,
            .vocab-item,
            .practice-box {
                page-break-inside: avoid;
                break-inside: avoid;
            }

            /* Allow page breaks between question boxes in two-column grid */
            .practice-grid .question-box {
                page-break-inside: avoid;
                break-inside: avoid;
            }

            /* Page continuation styling for print */
            .page-continue {
                display: block;
                text-align: right;
                font-size: 9pt;
                font-style: italic;
                color: #666;
                margin-top: 12pt;
                page-break-after: always;
                break-after: page;
            }

            @supports (break-after: page) {
                .page-continue::after {
                    content: " (Continued on next page)";
                }
            }

            /* Hide interactive elements */
            input[type="text"],
            input[type="checkbox"],
            textarea,
            .checkbox,
            .option-circle,
            .answer-bubble {
                border: 1px solid #ccc !important;
                background: white !important;
            }

            /* Adjust section backgrounds for print */
            .section-header {
                background: white !important;
                border-bottom: 2px solid #1e40af !important;
                print-color-adjust: exact;
                -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
                page-break-after: avoid !important;
                break-after: avoid !important;
            }

            .section-icon {
                background: #1e40af !important;
                color: white !important;
                print-color-adjust: exact;
                -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            }

            /* Ensure colored elements print correctly */
            .para-number {
                background: #1e40af !important;
                color: white !important;
                print-color-adjust: exact;
                -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            }

            /* Adjust images for print */
            img {
                max-width: 100%;
                page-break-inside: avoid;
                break-inside: avoid;
            }

            .article-image {
                page-break-inside: avoid;
                break-inside: avoid;
            }

            .article-image-area {
